text: This report submits the 2024-2033 Capital Budget of the Toronto Zoo. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the 2024-2033 Capital Budget on 2023-10-05 and recommended it for approval by the Board.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the 2024-2033 Capital Budget in Attachment 1 to the report (October 6, 2023) from the Director, Finance, Technology and Innovation, Toronto Zoo.
